abilities.name: Push Off
abilities.description: While moving alongside terrain, activate to slide toward a targeted location. Enemies hit take 100 damage and are Slowed by 75% for 1 second.; 20; D

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Dash
fields.notes: Lúcio's Basic Attack fires 4 pulses 0.125s apart, each doing the full amount of damage listed in his base stats. Push Off is disabled when Lúcio has not had a proper contact with a wall within the last 0.25 seconds (see note on Wall Ride).

abilities.name: Soundwave
abilities.description: Deal 105 damage to enemies in an area and knock them back.

abilities.name: Crossfade
abilities.description: Play one of two music tracks for Lúcio and his allies. Healing Boost: Passively heal Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes for 15 Health per second. Speed Boost: Increase the Movement Speed of Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes by 10%.

abilities.name: Amp It Up
abilities.description: Raise Lucio's Crossfade track volume for 3 seconds, amping Healing Boost to 112 Health per second and Speed Boost to 30% increased Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Sound Barrier
abilities.description: After a 1 second delay, grant yourself and all nearby allied Heroes a 1296 point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown.

abilities.name: High Five
abilities.description: Allied CooldownW 25 Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival, the ally is healed for 230, Lúcio is healed for 80 and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

fields.notes: Lúcio himself has no limit to how often he can be affected by the effects of this Ability. The Ability is interrupted if Lúcio cannot reach the target within 1.5 seconds or if the target moves farther than 12 units from Lúcio. Ally cooldown starts immediately when the Ability is used. The cooldown will not be refunded if the Ability gets interrupted.

abilities.name: Wall Ride
abilities.description: While moving alongside terrain, Lúcio begins to Wall Ride for 2 seconds. While Wall Ride is active, Lúcio can walk through units and gains 20% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.; mount

fields.notes: To (re)apply Wall Ride Lúcio must have proper contact with a wall: - Lúcio must be within 1.4 distance of proper terrain. - Lúcio's Movement Speed must be above 2.5. (This equates to being above ~52% of his base Movement Speed.) - Lúcio may not be Stunned, Dazed or Polymorphed. Once applied, Wall Ride and associated bonuses last for the given duration, even if Lúcio loses contact with a wall.

talents.name: Party Mix
talents.description: quest Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time. For every 1 minute played, permanently increase Lúcio's maximum Mana by 10. reward Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's radius by 20%.

fields.notes: Actually a 23% radius increase. Allies affected by Boombox also generate stacks for the quest, though they cannot give double credit from both auras simultaneously. Boombox also gains bonus radius from quest completion.

_raw_fields: quest Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time. For every 1 minute played, permanently increase Lúcio's maximum Mana by 10. reward Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's radius by 20%.

talents.name: Accelerando
talents.description: Wall Ride's Movement Speed bonus gradually increases to 40% over 6 seconds while Lúcio maintains its effect.

fields.notes: Wallride speed bonus is updated every 0.2 seconds in 1% increments.

_raw_fields: Wall Ride's Movement Speed bonus gradually increases to 40% over 6 seconds while Lúcio maintains its effect.

talents.name: Smooth Moves
talents.description: While Wall Ride is active, Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt and restore 0.5 Mana. Passive Increase Wall Ride's duration by 1 second.
_raw_fields: While Wall Ride is active, Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt and restore 0.5 Mana. Passive Increase Wall Ride's duration by 1 second.

talents.name: Subwoofer
talents.description: Enemies within the first half of Soundwave's range are knocked back 75% farther. quest Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Soundwave. Increase Soundwave's arc by 50% and its range by 20%.

fields.notes: Knockback speed remains unchanged. Bonus radius from completing the quest does not affect knockback distance. Quest reward increases the radius of the inner area in proportion, but not the arc.

_raw_fields: Enemies within the first half of Soundwave's range are knocked back 75% farther. quest Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Soundwave. Increase Soundwave's arc by 50% and its range by 20%.

talents.name: Off the Wall
talents.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave while Wall Ride is active sets its cooldown to 5 seconds and refunds 15 Mana.
_raw_fields: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave while Wall Ride is active sets its cooldown to 5 seconds and refunds 15 Mana.

talents.name: Supersonic
talents.description: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

fields.notes: Reduces the cooldown of Push Off by 0.125 seconds for every 0.125 seconds that Wall Ride is active.

_raw_fields: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

talents.name: Good Vibrations
talents.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave grants Lúcio a 38 point Shield for 8.5 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes grants 3 times this amount.

fields.notes: Shields from subsequent applications stack and refresh the duration.

_raw_fields: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave grants Lúcio a 38 point Shield for 8.5 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes grants 3 times this amount.

talents.name: Reverse Amp
talents.description: Blast Lúcio's Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50 damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%. This Ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.
_raw_fields: Blast Lúcio's Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50 damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%. This Ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.

talents.name: Boombox
talents.description: Cooldown 20 Active Place a boombox that plays Lúcio's active Crossfade track. Its volume adjusts with Amp It Up. Allied Heroes near the boombox gain 5 Armor. Crossfade tracks do not stack. Boombox Boombox Aura

fields.notes: Only 1 Boombox can be active at a time. Boombox aura has the same properties as Crossfade and benefits from healing modifiers affecting it. Boombox fully interacts with Party Mix, Rejuvenescência and Up to Eleven talents. Boombox healing is increased by the House Party talent, but allies in its aura do not generate stacks for it. Boombox does not interact with All Together or Summer Anthem talents.

talents.name: Slip
talents.description: While Wall Ride is active, passing near an enemy Hero increases its Movement Speed bonus to 40%, and grants 15 Armor, for 1 second.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Amp It Up by 0.3 seconds. Passive Wall Ride increases Basic Attack range by 2.2.

If Amp It Up is not active, these bonuses are granted to its next activation, up to 3 seconds. Passive Increase the duration of Amp It Up by 1 second.

talents.description: High Five can now be cast on enemy Heroes, dealing 160 damage and reducing all healing received by 50% for 3 seconds. Passive Reduce the Mana cost by 30% and cooldown of High Five by 30%.

fields.notes: Lúcio does not gain the self-benefits of High Five when it is cast on an enemy Hero.

fields.notes: Lúcio also generates a stack for this bonus.
